preconditions.description: The road width n is between 1 and 10^6.
The number of safety islands m is between 2 and the minimum of n+1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= d_i <= n for d_i in d)
preconditions.description: Each safety island coordinate d_i is between 0 and n.
All safety island coordinates are distinct.

preconditions.expression: 0 in d and n in d
preconditions.description: Safety islands are located at the beginning and end of the road.
The green light duration g is between 1 and 1000.
The red light duration r is between 1 and 1000.

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 indicating impossibility or a non-negative integer representing the minimum time.
The minimum time cannot exceed the total time for n full cycles of green and red lights.
